headline: Anthropic adds server-side message threads to its Claude API
summary: Anthropic’s Nov 2, 2026 platform release notes introduced beta message threads for the Claude Messages API and listed availability across Anthropic’s API and three managed cloud platforms. The official documentation says clients create a thread with the full conversation and continue it by sending only new messages plus the prior response ID; the service retains the conversation temporarily. Threads expire after five minutes without a request and are deleted within one hour after last use. Anthropic says this reduces repeated upload, validation and tokenization work, but reports no measured latency or cost results. The feature is not ZDR- or HIPAA-eligible and does not support compaction, context editing, token counting or message batches.
